<h1 class="sx-hero__name">Saxon Stockton</h1>

<p class="sx-hero__role">Astrophysics PhD Student · Texas Christian University</p>

<p class="sx-hero__pitch">
I pull physics out of starlight. My research maps the glowing gas in and around
30 Doradus, the most active star-forming region in the Local Group, to see what
a starburst does to its own galaxy. The rest of this site is my attempt to
explain work like that to anyone willing to read it.
</p>
